title: RunSessionCreateRequest
description: run.session-create-request@1 (the Desks plan's D6): the body of POST /api/v1/sessions on OpenVibe.Run (capability run.session.create), answered 201 with run.session@1 (state placing). The session is the caller's own: a person's token, or a first-party service acting for a person (X-OV-Subject; the service is recorded as via). MACHINE names one of the person's own machines (an OpenVibe.Bot device they own and let agents use): the session goes there or ends unplaceable, never elsewhere. Without it Run places the desk: on the person's own machines when REQUIREMENTS name user-owned (and only theirs), else on desk hosts that serve other people (first-party, then community, unless REQUIREMENTS narrow it), each of whose desks runs in its own sandbox. Absent REQUIREMENTS mean { kind: run.browser, mobility: session, latency_class: interactive, objective: balanced }. TTL_S (default 3600) and IDLE_S (default 900) bound its life. IDEMPOTENCY_KEY: a repeat from the same person within 24 h with an identical body answers the first session (200); with a different body 409 run.idempotency.conflict.

machine.description: One of the person's own machines, by its OpenVibe.Bot id; the session goes there or nowhere.
